import numpy as np, requests, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import OrderedDict
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
from scipy import stats
AA3to1={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
VDW={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80,'SE':1.90}
MAXASA={'A':129,'R':274,'N':195,'D':193,'C':167,'Q':225,'E':223,'G':104,'H':224,'I':197,
'L':201,'K':236,'M':224,'F':240,'P':159,'S':155,'T':172,'W':285,'Y':263,'V':174}
def load(url):
    t=requests.get(url,timeout=240).text; res=OrderedDict()
    for line in t.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("ENDMDL"): break
        if not line.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")): continue
        if line.startswith("HETATM") and line[17:20].strip()!="MSE": continue
        if line[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
        rn=line[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in AA3to1: continue
        nm=line[12:16].strip()
        if nm.startswith("H"): continue
        el=line[76:78].strip() or nm[0]
        if el not in VDW: continue
        res.setdefault((line[21],int(line[22:26])),{"aa":AA3to1[rn],"at":[]})["at"].append(
            ([float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])],VDW[el]))
    return res
def shrake(res,probe=1.4,npt=192):
    keys=list(res); xyz=[];rad=[];own=[]
    for k in keys:
        for c,r in res[k]["at"]: xyz.append(c); rad.append(r+probe); own.append(k)
    xyz=np.array(xyz); rad=np.array(rad)
    g=(1+5**0.5)/2; i=np.arange(npt)
    th=np.arccos(1-2*(i+0.5)/npt); ph=2*np.pi*i/g
    S=np.stack([np.sin(th)*np.cos(ph),np.sin(th)*np.sin(ph),np.cos(th)],1)
    nb=cKDTree(xyz).query_ball_point(xyz,rad+rad.max()); asa={k:0.0 for k in keys}
    for a in range(len(xyz)):
        pts=xyz[a]+rad[a]*S; n=[b for b in nb[a] if b!=a]
        acc=(np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None,:]-xyz[n][None,:,:],axis=2)>=rad[n][None,:]).all(1) if n else np.ones(npt,bool)
        asa[own[a]]+=acc.mean()*4*np.pi*rad[a]**2
    return asa
ce={k:v for k,v in load("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-G5EDF6-F1-model_v6.pdb").items() if k[1]<=270}
a=shrake(ce); RSA={k[1]:(ce[k]["aa"],a[k]/MAXASA[ce[k]["aa"]]) for k in ce}

B=np.array([[int(v) for v in r.split()] for r in B62.strip().split("\n")],float)
IDX={c:i for i,c in enumerate(AAO)}
def enc(s): return np.array([IDX.get(c,-1) for c in s])
def dp_fast(s,g=-5.0):
    n,m=s.shape; F=np.empty((n+1,m+1)); F[0,:]=g*np.arange(m+1); F[:,0]=g*np.arange(n+1); jj=np.arange(1,m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        tmp=np.maximum(F[i-1,0:m]+s[i-1,:],F[i-1,1:m+1]+g)
        aa=np.empty(m+1); aa[0]=F[i,0]; aa[1:]=tmp-g*jj
        F[i,1:]=g*jj+np.maximum.accumulate(aa)[1:]
    i,j=n,m; al=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if abs(F[i,j]-(F[i-1,j-1]+s[i-1,j-1]))<1e-9: al.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif abs(F[i,j]-(F[i-1,j]+g))<1e-9: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return al[::-1]
ACC=["G5EDF6","A8Y464","Q9Y366","Q62559","Q5PRA7","A0A8V0ZX64","A0ACM8PY45","A0A084VMI8",
"A0A7M7GTU7","A0A6P4XR08","Q946G4","Q388B0","Q4QDI9","A0A644F860","A0A8J5MA87"]
SEQ={x:"".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{x}.fasta",timeout=90).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip() for x in ACC}
ref=SEQ["G5EDF6"][:280]; rq=enc(ref); cols={p:[] for p in range(1,281)}
for x in ACC[1:]:
    s=SEQ[x][:400]; rs=enc(s)
    sc=np.where((rq[:,None]>=0)&(rs[None,:]>=0),B[np.clip(rq,0,19)[:,None],np.clip(rs,0,19)[None,:]],-4.0)
    m={i:j for i,j in dp_fast(sc,-5.0)}
    for p in range(1,281): j=m.get(p-1); cols[p].append(s[j] if j is not None else "-")
cons={p:sum(1 for c in cols[p] if c==ref[p-1])/14 for p in range(1,281)}
pos=np.array(sorted(RSA)); rsa=np.array([RSA[p][1] for p in pos]); cns=np.array([cons[p] for p in pos])
bur=rsa<0.15; exp=rsa>0.40
u=stats.mannwhitneyu(cns[bur],cns[exp],alternative='greater'); rho=stats.spearmanr(rsa,cns)

fig,axs=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.6),gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1.5,1,1.5]})
ax=axs[0]
ax.scatter(rsa,cns+np.random.default_rng(0).normal(0,.012,len(cns)),s=16,c="#aab6c4",edgecolor="none")
MARK={70:"P70 oxyanion",96:"S96 nucleophile pos.",97:"G97 post-nucleophile",
      171:"Y171 pocket floor",223:"S223 triad His pos.",225:"F225 triad Glu pos."}
for p,l in MARK.items():
    ax.scatter(RSA[p][1],cons[p],s=70,c="#c0392b",zorder=5,edgecolor="white",lw=.8)
    ax.annotate(l,(RSA[p][1],cons[p]),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(8,4),fontsize=7.5,color="#c0392b")
ax.axvline(0.15,ls=":",c="#777",lw=1); ax.axvline(0.40,ls=":",c="#777",lw=1)
ax.text(0.03,1.06,"buried",fontsize=8,color="#555"); ax.text(0.55,1.06,"exposed",fontsize=8,color="#555")
ax.set_xlabel("relative solvent accessibility (Shrake-Rupley, OSM-6 AlphaFold)",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("identity to OSM-6 across 14 orthologs",fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("A  Conservation tracks burial in the GIFT domain",fontsize=10.5,loc="left")
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

ax=axs[1]
bp=ax.boxplot([cns[bur],cns[exp]],labels=[f"buried\nn={bur.sum()}",f"exposed\nn={exp.sum()}"],
              widths=.55,patch_artist=True,showfliers=False)
for b,c in zip(bp['boxes'],["#4a6fa5","#d49a6a"]): b.set_facecolor(c); b.set_alpha(.75)
for i,d in enumerate([cns[bur],cns[exp]]):
    ax.scatter(np.random.default_rng(1).normal(i+1,.07,len(d)),d,s=7,c="#333",alpha=.35,zorder=3)
ax.set_ylabel("identity to OSM-6",fontsize=9)
ax.set_title(f"B  buried {cns[bur].mean():.3f} vs exposed {cns[exp].mean():.3f}\n"
             f"Mann-Whitney p = {u.pvalue:.1e}",fontsize=10,loc="left")
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

ax=axs[2]
w=9; sm=np.convolve(cns,np.ones(w)/w,mode="same"); smr=np.convolve(rsa,np.ones(w)/w,mode="same")
ax.plot(pos,sm,c="#2b6ca3",lw=1.6,label="identity (9-res mean)")
ax.plot(pos,smr,c="#d4722a",lw=1.2,alpha=.8,label="RSA (9-res mean)")
for p in MARK: ax.axvline(p,c="#c0392b",lw=.8,alpha=.55)
ax.set_xlabel("OSM-6 residue",fontsize=9); ax.set_ylabel("value",fontsize=9)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False)

for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
